description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Door Latch Plastic Clip Set.
Each Door Latch Has Three of These Plastic Clips.
Contains Exact Replacement Clips to Repair the Broken Latch Clips on Any Lock.
These are the original clips with Snap-In & Lock Down Features.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Latch Rod Clips
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
